name: CSS Stacking Cards
description: Sticky cards that pile up on scroll, each one pinning and scaling back as the next slides over it, powered entirely by a named CSS view timeline with exit-crossing animation ranges. Zero JavaScript.
usage: Include styles.css, then add a <ul class="sdc-cards"> with one <li class="sdc-card"> per card, each wrapping a <div class="sdc-card__content"> (text plus optional .sdc-card__art figure). Set --sdc-numcards on the wrapper to match your card count; positions 1 to 6 are indexed automatically and the knobs (--sdc-card-height, --sdc-gap, --sdc-top-offset, --sdc-scale-step) are plain custom properties on the wrapper.
